summary.text: BRØDRENE HANSEN AS is a private limited company registered in Rjukan, founded 1992-08-21. BRØDRENE HANSEN AS engages in transport and other activities connected to it, including participating in other businesses. Its main industry code is 49.410: freight transport by road. The register shows 15 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 27 186 919 NOK and the annual result was 12 525 213 NOK; operating income was down from 28 019 506 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 5 695 545 NOK in 2024 to 12 525 213 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 11 271 763 NOK in 2024 to 19 796 976 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 12 on 2025-11-13 to 15 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
